title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 830 Kuhn Drive in Chula Vista, California, as the "Jonathan 'J.D.' De Guzman Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 830 Kuhn Drive in Chula Vista, California, as the "Jonathan 'J.D.' De Guzman Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A federal law renames a United States Postal Service building in Chula Vista, California, after Jonathan "J.D." De Guzman.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the Postal Service facility at 830 Kuhn Drive in Chula Vista, California, the "Jonathan 'J.D.' De Guzman Post Office Building." It changes only the name of the building and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves. The law was signed on December 16, 2016.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The designation took effect when the law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
